mission: Make customer-inspectable, reproducible security evidence the highest-priority R&D output for Standment and continuously convert THE WORLD research into defensible AI-native security portfolio assets.
daily_target: One material evidence improvement per day; evidence before claims.

senju_collaboration.rule: Senju improves research-process quality, reproducibility, counterevidence and selection robustness. It never receives third-party targets, credentials, exploit instructions, authorization scope, or permission to alter external systems.

tracks.title: Standment Security Scan dogfood + Before/After case study
tracks.hypothesis: Repeated dogfooding on owned assets plus before/after evidence will turn Security Scan from a build artifact into a credible customer-facing case study.
tracks.deliverable: Human-readable scan report, before/after remediation evidence, reproducibility notes and bounded limitations.
tracks.customer_usefulness: A buyer can see what was found, what was changed, and whether the defensive change actually improved the owned system instead of trusting a generic security claim.

tracks.title: Customer Security Evidence Pack
tracks.hypothesis: A standard evidence-pack contract will reduce the distance from verified engineering work to a customer-inspectable security deliverable.
tracks.deliverable: Evidence Pack template covering finding, severity, proof, remediation, retest, limitations and rollback.
tracks.customer_usefulness: Security work can be handed to a customer as a consistent evidence package instead of a loose collection of code, screenshots and engineering notes.

tracks.title: Software supply-chain evidence portfolio
tracks.hypothesis: Combining CodeQL, dependency review, SBOM and security-gate evidence into one reproducible pack will create a stronger defensive security portfolio artifact.
tracks.deliverable: Supply-chain assurance evidence pack with repeatable checks and clear pass/fail boundaries.
tracks.customer_usefulness: A customer or reviewer can inspect dependency, code-analysis and build-chain evidence in one place and understand what is checked automatically on each change.

tracks.title: Auth / tenant / RLS defensive evidence kit
tracks.hypothesis: A fail-closed, evidence-first checklist for owned databases will make authorization and RLS findings safer to remediate and easier to explain to customers.
tracks.deliverable: Owned-system authorization review kit with caller mapping, before/after grants, policy evidence and rollback proof.
tracks.customer_usefulness: Teams can verify who is allowed to access what, see before/after authorization evidence, and reduce the risk of tenant or policy mistakes on owned systems.

tracks.title: Autonomous-agent security and auditability pack
tracks.hypothesis: Explicit action boundaries, evidence trails and independent verification can become a differentiated defensive-security portfolio for autonomous AI systems.
tracks.deliverable: Agent-security architecture note plus auditable run evidence, failure cases and independent verification.
tracks.customer_usefulness: An operator can inspect what an autonomous AI was allowed to do, what it actually did, what failed, and how evidence was preserved for review.

tracks.title: Incident readiness and recovery evidence pack
tracks.hypothesis: A repeatable recovery-evidence package for owned systems will make incident readiness demonstrable instead of policy-only.
tracks.deliverable: Customer-readable incident readiness pack covering detection assumptions, rollback, backup/restore evidence, recovery objectives, retest results and known limitations.
tracks.customer_usefulness: A buyer can inspect whether recovery procedures are actually evidenced and repeatable rather than relying on a statement that backups or rollback exist.

tracks.title: Continuous security retainer scorecard
tracks.hypothesis: A compact recurring scorecard that links findings, remediation, retest and evidence freshness will make Standment security work easier to operate as an ongoing service.
tracks.deliverable: Human-readable monthly/continuous security scorecard with evidence freshness, open risks, resolved risks, regressions and next remediation priorities.
tracks.customer_usefulness: A customer can understand what improved since the previous review, what regressed, and what needs attention next without reading engineering logs.

tracks.title: Security architecture review pack for AI and SaaS systems
tracks.hypothesis: A standardized architecture-review evidence pack can convert Standment's internal defensive standards into a reusable customer-facing assessment format.
tracks.deliverable: Architecture review pack covering trust boundaries, identity, data classification, external ingest, secrets, CI/CD, observability, recovery and evidence-backed recommendations.
tracks.customer_usefulness: A customer can receive a structured architecture review that explains risks, evidence, remediation priority and residual uncertainty in a consistent format.

tracks.title: AI Agent Permission Boundary Lab
tracks.hypothesis: A reproducible permission-boundary lab for autonomous agents will make Standment's AI security work inspectable instead of policy-only.
tracks.deliverable: Agent permission map, allowed/blocked action matrix, audit trail examples, failure evidence and recovery behavior on owned test systems.
tracks.customer_usefulness: An AI product team can inspect exactly what an agent may do, what it is blocked from doing, and whether controls fail closed under adverse inputs.

tracks.title: LLM Security Evaluation Harness
tracks.hypothesis: A bounded defensive evaluation harness for prompt-injection, data-boundary and tool-use failures can become a differentiated AI-security portfolio artifact.
tracks.deliverable: Owned-system LLM security eval specification with benign/adversarial test cases, expected safe behavior, regression evidence and limitations.
tracks.customer_usefulness: AI teams can repeatedly test whether model/tool integrations preserve data and action boundaries when prompts attempt to bypass them.

tracks.title: Security Evidence Dashboard
tracks.hypothesis: A compact evidence dashboard that shows verified, building and missing proof across security products will make R&D progress and customer readiness visible every day.
tracks.deliverable: Machine-readable plus human-readable portfolio index showing track status, evidence coverage, latest lab note, missing proof and promotion gate.
tracks.customer_usefulness: A buyer, engineer or CEO can understand what is real, what is still being built, and which evidence supports each security claim without reading source code.
